# Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.**

Email **security@chatlychat.com** with:

- what you found, and the smallest set of steps that shows it
- which surface it affects — the REST API, the widget on a customer page, the
  dashboard, or one of the published packages
- whether you needed credentials, and of what kind

We will acknowledge within **3 working days** and tell you what we think the
severity is and when we expect to ship a fix. If we disagree with your
severity we will say so and explain why, rather than going quiet.

## Scope

In scope: the hosted API at `api.chatlychat.com`, the widget bundle served
from our CDN, the dashboard at `app.chatlychat.com`, and every published SDK —
the `@chatlychat/*` packages on npm and the source in this organisation.

Out of scope: findings that need a compromised customer device, rate-limit
observations with no demonstrated impact, and reports generated by a scanner
with no reproduction attached.

## What helps

A signature or payload we can replay, and the exact request. If the issue is
in signature verification, tell us which of our signing schemes you were
checking — there are several and they differ by surface, which is documented
at [Verifying requests from Chatly](https://chatlychat.com/docs/api-external-agents).
